newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-NIMES TRAVEL TO PACIFIC FOR CUP GAME.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NIMES TRAVEL TO PACIFIC FOR CUP GAME.

text.p: French third division Nimes, who reached the second round of the European Cup Winners' Cup this season, have not lost their taste for flying high.
Nimes completed the outward leg of a 56-hour round trip on Tuesday to the tiny Pacific island of New Caledonia where they meet Saint-Louis in a French Cup tie at the weekend.
They could be in for a second bad landing after Cup Winners' Cup elimination by AIK Stockholm when they face their amateur opponents in Moumea minus four key players, suspended or injured.
But the Nimes players are determined to make the most of their week-long trip halfway round the world to the birthplace of Sampdoria's French international Christian Karembeu.
They have foregone their match bonuses in order to contribute towards the tickets as tourists of suspended team mates Cyril Jeunechamp and Omar Belbey and injured Polish goalkeeper Stanislas Karwat.

Saint-Louis, like other sides from far away French territories, have come through from the early rounds of the cup to the stage where second division clubs like 1976 European Cup finalists Saint-Etienne enter the fray.
